candidates.change_summary: Delete the balance update statement so deposits no longer credit the caller.
Credit a fixed amount of 1 wei instead of the deposited msg.value.
Overwrite the balance with msg.value instead of adding to it.
Credit tx.origin instead of msg.sender so calls via intermediaries credit a different key.
Insert an extra statement crediting the contract itself so an additional key's balance changes.
Remove the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum no longer updates MinSum.
Change the assignment to 'MinSum = _val + 1;' so the stored value differs from the input.
Change the assignment to 'MinSum += _val;' so the value accumulates instead of being overwritten.
Remove the 'require(!intitalized);' guard so SetMinSum can still modify MinSum after initialization, changing MinSum in sequences where the original reverts.
Delete the require(!intitalized) check so SetMinSum can be called after initialization and overwrite MinSum.
Replace the require(!intitalized) guard with require(intitalized), making SetMinSum only work after initialization.
Change assignment to addition so SetMinSum accumulates values instead of overwriting MinSum.
Remove the assignment `Log = LogFile(_log);` so the Log contract address is never set (remains address(0)).
Replace the assignment `Log = LogFile(_log);` with `Log = LogFile(address(0));` so the stored Log address is always zero instead of the caller-supplied address.
Replace the assignment `Log = LogFile(_log);` with `MinSum = _val;` so the supplied address is written into MinSum instead of the Log variable, leaving Log at address(0).
Replace the balance update with a direct assignment so the deposit overwrites instead of accumulating the balance.
Replace msg.value with a constant 1 in the balance increment so any deposit only adds 1 wei to the recorded balance.
Delete the statement that decrements balances[msg.sender], so collected funds are never deducted from the sender's balance.
Change the condition check balances[msg.sender]>=_am to balances[msg.sender]>_am, so a withdrawal equal to the full balance is no longer allowed.
Delete the MinSum check from the condition, allowing withdrawals of amounts below MinSum.
Replace _am with balances[msg.sender] in the call value so the entire remaining balance is sent instead of _am.
Delete the Log.AddMessage(...) call on successful collection, so the log history no longer records the Collect event.
Negate the success check by replacing if(_veri_ok) with if(!_veri_ok), so the log message is only added on failure and successful collections revert.
